Container.Name: pinkcollab-omp
Container.Overview: Oh My Pi + PinkCollab Gateway + Orca Server. PinkCollab via Cloudflare, Orca for Linux and Android over private LAN/Teleport VPN.
Container.Description: One non-root container runs original OMP, PinkCollab Gateway and Orca Server with supervised processes and persistent projects. Orca is LAN/VPN only, not a public internet service.

Config.Name: Orca pairing address (Unraid LAN IP)
Config.Description: LAN address clients use; access via LAN or UniFi Teleport VPN, never a public port forward

Config.Name: Orca Server port (private LAN/VPN)
Config.Description: WebSocket port for Orca Desktop/Mobile, no router WAN forwarding

Config.Name: Persistent agent home (appdata)
Config.Description: All OMP sessions, PinkCollab settings, auth, SSH, CLI tools, and future home directories persist in appdata

Config.Name: Workspace on cachedl
Config.Description: Separate persistent work directory on cachedl, outside appdata and Unraid mover
